items.issue: partyRow() ends with .locator('..'), which Playwright resolves as an XPath parent-axis selector — the best-practices doc explicitly flags XPath selectors as brittle/avoid
items.fix: Prefer a role/structure-based ascent, e.g. filter the summary-list row directly (getByRole('group')/row-level locator) instead of climbing via XPath '..' from the term
